techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/scout/_port/fixture.ts:4 The whole-implementation fork. app/(studio)/projects/[id]/_part/real.ts:215 The shipped port is built by the same factory the suite calls, so the tested path is the production construction with only store, clock and gates injected.
tests/mutants-unit/registry.ts:3307 Seeded breaks exist for real.ts, realResearch.ts, realScript.ts, actions.ts and schema.ts in this context.

pairs.registryProposal: fixture-economics gives no floor below which a per-test build of a small embedded store is acceptable; a stated ratio or absolute cost would let a seat tell a real defect from a shape match without timing it.
